  message: false

```{r, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
stopifnot(
  exists('variant'),
  is.data.frame(variant)
)
```

```{r results='asis', echo=FALSE}
# `v` is a one-row tibble passed in from index.qmd

ft <-
  variant %>%
    select(CHROM, POS, REF, ALT, HGVSp, HGVSc, CADD) %>% 
  cavalier:::flex_table(transpose = T)

html <- htmltools::renderTags(flextable::htmltools_value(ft))$html
# emit *just* the table HTML
cat(html)
```
